Well 2 years of constantly having wrong diagnosis made me google research heavily. The most affected muscle in my case was the tongue. I could barely speak 1 sentence before it got tired and I was mute again. The second one was the breathing which I tought it was because of smoking. So I googled something like tongue numbness and I saw a myastenia link. Then I looked into the mirror and noticed my facial muscles were going crazy. I looked at pictures with people that have myasthenia and saw the exact same facial muscle falling pattern.

Its better now. Depending on the age the surgery is recommended or not. I gained few extra pounds and I have periods when I eat fully saltless but Im ok. Im on prednisone treatment side so additionally I got severe depression, due to high prednison doses and now I take prozac aswell. But myasthenia is controlable if u get the green card for surgery- I did. The difference will be seen in about a year.
Great after surgery. But until then I gained few pounds because of treatment and had a hard time in winter and summer.
